seoTitle: Apartment , The Thomond, The Strand, Ennis Road, Co. Limerick
description:
KMPM are pleased to present this this stunning, bright, dual-aspect two bed, second-floor apartment located in the Strand apartments Ennis Road Limerick. The apartment features a spacious living room, fitted kitchen with appliances, balcony with amazing views of  Limerick City and the River Shannon.
There are two double bedrooms, including a principal bedroom with walk in wardrobes and an en-suite,  guest bathroom and hallway storage.

Located in a secure gated development with landscaped gardens,  lift access and a designated underground parking space.

Situated on the banks of the River Shannon, the apartment is a short walk from Limerick city centre, riverside walks, cafés, restaurants and Thomond Park, with easy access to the N18, M7 and M20.

Refuse collection and one parking space included in the monthly rent. 

*** Viewing is highly recommended*** 

****We invite Tenants CV's from HomeHak for all of our rental properties*****
